title: QA Pilot Training Sim Result
description: Schema for a simulation result produced by running a training sim case. Results are read-only advisory artifacts — they cannot authorize downstream action.

sim_id.description: References the sim case that was executed.

observations.description: Free-text observations about the simulation run.

advisory.description: Must be true — results are read-only advisory artifacts.

generated_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of result generation.
